name: ai-agent-ports
title: AI Agent Ports
description: Monitor and toggle the caffeinate state of your running AI coding agents — Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Cursor — from the menu bar, so long sessions never sleep mid-task.
author: ericxxx530

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: AI Agent Status
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Show how many AI agent sessions are caffeinated in the menu bar, with one-click toggles to keep them awake or release them.

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Manage AI Agents
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: List running AI agent sessions grouped by project and caffeinate, release, pause, resume, or kill them.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Ports CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the `ports` binary. Leave blank to auto-detect common install locations.

preferences.name: agentRoles
preferences.title: Roles to Show
preferences.description: Comma-separated `role` values from `ports find` to display. "agent" is the main interactive process; use "*" to show every role.

preferences.name: extraQueries
preferences.title: Extra Search Terms
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra terms passed to `ports find`, in addition to the built-in Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Cursor.
